target.title: fix(zalouser): probe timeout reported as Not authenticated
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the Zalouser **channel status probe** treated a lookup timeout as `"Not authenticated"`. `Promise.race` resolved `null` on timeout, which collided with a real null user from `getZaloUserInfo`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Discriminate timeout vs user outcome in the race (`{ kind: "timeout" }` vs `{ kind: "user" }`). Timeout returns `error: "timed out"`; a null user still returns `"Not authenticated"`. Note: `getZaloUserInfo` is not abortable yet, so a timed-out probe ends the wait without cancelling the underlying call — this PR fixes the misdiagnosis first.

Scope note: this changes `probeZalouser` / `status.probeAccount` / channel status `probe.error`. It does **not** change `collectZalouserStatusIssues` (configured/login issues still use `"Not authenticated (no saved Zalo session)."` via `checkZcaAuthenticated`).

## User Impact

**Before:** Slow/hung Zalo account lookup looked like missing login on the channel probe payload (`probe.error: "Not authenticated"`).

**After:** Channel status probe reports `timed out` on deadline expiry, and only reports `Not authenticated` when the lookup completes with no user.

## Evidence

### Proof (exit 0)

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
stdout | extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > times out when lookup takes too long
[zalouser channel-visible timeout proof] timed_out=true summary.probe.error=timed out not_authenticated=false

 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > returns ok=true with user when authenticated 226ms
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > returns not authenticated when no user info is returned 1ms
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > returns error when user lookup throws 3ms
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > times out when lookup takes too long 4ms
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > still reports Not authenticated when lookup returns null before timeout 1ms
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > clears the probe timeout after auth resolves 1ms
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > caps oversized lookup timeout before scheduling 1ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Channel status probe timeout is no longer reported as `"Not authenticated"`.
- **Canonical reachability path:** `zalouserPlugin.status.probeAccount` → `probeZalouser(profile, timeoutMs)` → discriminated race → `{ ok: false, error: "timed out" }` → `buildPassiveProbedChannelStatusSummary` exposes `summary.probe.error`.
- **Boundary crossed:** Stalled Zalo user lookup → timeout error string distinct from unauth on the channel probe payload.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** Keeps `resolveTimerTimeoutMs` clamp; does not claim abort of `getZaloUserInfo` (not supported yet); does not claim doctor `collectZalouserStatusIssues` wording changes.
- **Observed result after fix:** `timed_out=true summary.probe.error=timed out not_authenticated=false` (see proof log); null-before-timeout still `"Not authenticated"`.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix (misdiagnosis); follow-up for abortable lookup if API allows.

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor)
- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
